answer_1.quote: We present results on three cross-script WMT datasets: Hindi(hi)/Gujarati(gu)/Tamil(ta)→English(en). ... The goal is to translate source sentences (or transliterate) into English.
answer_1.outputs: English translations (and transliterations) of the source sentences

answer_2.quote: We use SacreBLEU to evaluate our models. ... We report BLEU scores ... We also report word‑level F1 scores for transliteration decisions.

answer_4.quote: We ask raters to evaluate each source‑target pair on a scale of 0‑6 similar to ..., where 0 is the lowest and 6 is the highest. We have three human raters compare the base and test system translations using 500 randomly chosen source sentences.
answer_4.guideline: Human raters score each translation on a 0‑6 scale (adequacy/fluency) and perform side‑by‑side comparisons (SxS).
